| spellname = Arch Lich
| spellicon = G
| description = Grips your body in an unholy darkness, slowly draining your hit points while regenerating your mana.

This spell is later buffed March 12, 2002 (post-Velious) when Demi Lich is downgraded to a level 56 spell. It is at this point that Arch Lich became 36 hp for 35 mana.

Does '''not''' stack with any clarity spells.

'''Does''' stack with bard mana songs.
